// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract TokenVesting {
    address public beneficiary;
    uint256 public start;
    uint256 public duration;
    uint256 public initialRelease;

    event TokensReleased(address indexed beneficiary, uint256 amount);

    error SafeMath__AdditionOverflow();
    error SafeMath__SubtractionOverflow();
    error SafeMath__DivisionByZero();
    error SafeMath__MultiplicationOverflow();
    error SafeMath__DivisionRoundsUp();

    constructor() {
        beneficiary = address(0);
        start = 0;
        duration = 0;
        initialRelease = 0;
    }

    function released(address token) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _released(token);
    }

    function release(address token) external {
        require(msg.sender == beneficiary, "Sender is not beneficiary");
        uint256 amount = _releasableAmount(token);
        require(amount > 0, "TokenVesting: no tokens are due");
        _setReleased(token, _released(token) + amount);
        _safeTransfer(token, beneficiary, amount);
        emit TokensReleased(beneficiary, amount);
    }

    function _released(address token) internal view returns (uint256 amount) {
        amount = _getStorageUint256(_getReleasedSlot(token));
    }

    function _setReleased(address token, uint256 amount) internal {
        _setStorageUint256(_getReleasedSlot(token), amount);
    }

    function _getReleasedSlot(address token) internal pure returns (uint256 slot) {
        slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(token, uint256(0))));
    }

    function _getStorageUint256(uint256 slot) internal view returns (uint256 value) {
        assembly {
            value := sload(slot)
        }
    }

    function _setStorageUint256(uint256 slot, uint256 value) internal {
        assembly {
            sstore(slot, value)
        }
    }

    function _releasableAmount(address token) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 totalBalance = _balanceOf(token, address(this));
        uint256 vestedAmount = _vestedAmount(totalBalance);
        uint256 alreadyReleased = _released(token);
        return vestedAmount - alreadyReleased;
    }

    function _vestedAmount(uint256 totalBalance) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (block.timestamp < start) {
            return 0;
        }
        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - start;
        if (elapsed >= duration) {
            return totalBalance;
        }
        uint256 initialAmount = (totalBalance * initialRelease) / 100;
        uint256 remaining = totalBalance - initialAmount;
        uint256 vestedRemaining = (remaining * elapsed) / duration;
        return initialAmount + vestedRemaining;
    }

    function _balanceOf(address token, address account) internal view returns (uint256) {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x70a08231, account));
        require(success && data.length >= 32, "Balance call failed");
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0xa9059cbb, to, amount));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "Transfer failed");
    }
}

// Constants string private constant _name = "PuppersNFT"; string private constant _symbol = "PUP"; string private constant _baseURI = "https://meta.puppersnft.com/"; uint256 private constant _price = 0.05 ether; // 50000000000000000 wei // Storage address private _owner; uint256 private _totalSupply; mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners; mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals; mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals; mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokens; mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex; mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex; mapping(address => uint256) private _allocations; mapping(address => uint256) private _privateSalePurchases; // Sale State (packed in slot 10) // byte 0: private sale active // byte 1: public sale active // bytes 2-21: private sale signer address // bytes 22-41: public sale signer address modifier onlyOwner() { require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner"); _; } constructor() { _transferOwnership(msg.sender); } // --- ERC165 --- function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure returns (bool) { return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // ERC165 interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721 interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f; // ERC721Metadata } // --- ERC721Metadata --- function name() public pure returns (string memory) { return _name; } function symbol() public pure returns (string memory) { return _symbol; } function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (string memory) { require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721Metadata: URI query for nonexistent token"); return string(abi.encodePacked(_baseURI, _toString(tokenId))); } // --- ERC721Enumerable --- function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) { return _totalSupply; } function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner, uint256 index) public view returns (uint256) { require(index < balanceOf(owner), "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds"); return _ownedTokens[uint256(uint160(owner)) + index]; // Simplified mapping logic } function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) public view returns (uint256) { require(index < totalSupply(), "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds"); uint256 stored = _allocations[address(uint160(index))]; return stored; } // --- ERC721 --- function balanceOf(address owner) public view returns (uint256) { require(owner != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for the zero address"); return _balances[owner]; } function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) { address owner = _owners[tokenId]; require(owner != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token"); return owner; } function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) public { address owner = ownerOf(tokenId); require(to != owner, "ERC721: approval to current owner"); require( msg.sender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, msg.sender), "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all" ); _approve(to, tokenId); } function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) { require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: approved query for nonexistent token"); return _tokenApprovals[tokenId]; } function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public { _setApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved); } function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) public view returns (bool) { return _operatorApprovals[owner][operator]; } function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public { require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved"); _transfer(from, to, tokenId); } function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public { safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, ""); } function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public { require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved"); _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data); } // --- Ownable --- function owner() public view returns (address) { return _owner; } function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner { _transferOwnership(address(0)); } function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner { require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address"); _transferOwnership(newOwner); } // --- Sale Functions --- function private_sale_minting() public view returns (bool) { return _getPrivateSaleActive(); } function public_sale_minting() public view returns (bool) { return _getPublicSaleActive(); } function allocations(address account) public view returns (uint256) { return _allocations[account]; } function togglePrivateSale() public onlyOwner { _setPrivateSaleActive(!_getPrivateSaleActive()); } function togglePublicSale() public onlyOwner { _setPublicSaleActive(!_getPublicSaleActive()); } function addPresale(address[] memory accounts) public onlyOwner { for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) { _allocations[accounts[i]] = 1; } } function privateSaleMint(uint256 amount) public payable { require(_getPrivateSaleActive(), "Minting is currently disabled"); require(amount > 0 && amount <= 10, "Invalid number of tokens to mint"); require(msg.value == _price * amount, "Incorrect ETH sent to mint"); require(_allocations[msg.sender] > 0, "Not enough allocation to mint presale"); require(_privateSalePurchases[msg.sender] + amount <= 10, "Not enough tokens left to mint"); for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) { _privateSalePurchases[msg.sender] += 1; _safeMint(msg.sender); } } function publicSaleMint(uint256 amount) public payable { require(_getPublicSaleActive(), "Minting is currently disabled"); require(amount > 0 && amount <= 10, "Invalid number of tokens to mint"); require(msg.value == _price * amount, "Incorrect ETH sent to mint"); for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) { _safeMint(msg.sender); } } function ownerMint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner { for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) { _safeMint(to); } } function withdraw() public onlyOwner { payable(0xAfCA9a21Ae7c376CEf7844373380c81BAda0dcB9).transfer(address(this).balance); } // --- Internal Functions --- function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) { return _owners[tokenId] != address(0); } function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) { address owner = ownerOf(tokenId); return (spender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, spender) || getApproved(tokenId) == spender); } function _safeMint(address to) internal { uint256 tokenId = _totalSupply; _totalSupply += 1; _mint(to, tokenId); } function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal { require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address"); require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted"); _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId); _balances[to] += 1; _owners[tokenId] = to; emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId); } function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal { require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer of token that is not own"); require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address"); _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId); _approve(address(0), tokenId); _balances[from] -= 1; _balances[to] += 1; _owners[tokenId] = to; emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId); } function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal { _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to; emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId); } function _setApprovalForAll(address owner, address operator, bool approved) internal { require(owner != operator, "ERC721: approve to caller"); _operatorApprovals[owner][operator] = approved; emit ApprovalForAll(owner, operator, approved); } function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal { _transfer(from, to, tokenId); require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer"); } function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) { if (to.code.length > 0) { try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) { return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector; } catch (bytes memory reason) { if (reason.length == 0) { revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer"); } else { assembly { revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason)) } } } } else { return true; } } function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal { if (from == address(0)) { _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId); } else if (from != to) { _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId); } if (to == address(0)) { _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId); } else if (to != from) { _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId); } } function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) private { uint256 length = balanceOf(to); _ownedTokens[uint256(uint160(to)) + length] = tokenId; _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length; } function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private { uint256 lastTokenIndex = balanceOf(from) - 1; uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId]; if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) { uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[uint256(uint160(from)) + lastTokenIndex]; _ownedTokens[uint256(uint160(from)) + tokenIndex] = lastTokenId; _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex; } delete _ownedTokens[uint256(uint160(from)) + lastTokenIndex]; delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId]; } function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private { _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = totalSupply(); _allocations[address(uint160(totalSupply()))] = tokenId; } function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private { uint256 lastTokenIndex = totalSupply() - 1; uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId]; if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) { uint256 lastTokenId = _allocations[address(uint160(lastTokenIndex))]; _allocations[address(uint160(tokenIndex))] = lastTokenId; _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex; } delete _allocations[address(uint160(lastTokenIndex))]; delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId]; } function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal { address oldOwner = _owner; _owner = newOwner; emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner); } function _getPrivateSaleActive() internal view returns (bool) { return uint8(_getSlotValue(10) >> 0) == 1; } function _setPrivateSaleActive(bool active) internal { uint256 slot = _getSlotValue(10); if (active) { slot |= (1 << 0); } else { slot &= ~(uint256(1) << 0); } assembly { sstore(10, slot) } } function _getPublicSaleActive() internal view returns (bool) { return uint8(_getSlotValue(10) >> 8) == 1; } function _setPublicSaleActive(bool active) internal { uint256 slot = _getSlotValue(10); if (active) { slot |= (1 << 8); } else { slot &= ~(uint256(1) << 8); } assembly { sstore(10, slot) } } function _getSlotValue(uint256 slot) internal view returns (uint256 val) { assembly { val := sload(slot) } } function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) { if (value == 0) { return "0"; } uint256 temp = value; uint256 digits; while (temp != 0) { digits++; temp /= 10; } bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits); while (value != 0) { digits -= 1; buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10))); value /= 10; } return string(buffer); } } interface IERC721Receiver { function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4); } PuppersNFT

    string private _symbol;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;

    address public immutable MUSD = 0xc1443Cb9ce81915fB914C270d74B0D57D1c87be0;

    address public connector;
    address public unwrapper;

    bool public automateInterestCollection;

    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
    event Deposit(address indexed mAsset, address indexed saver, uint256 amount, uint256 credits);
    event Withdraw(address indexed mAsset, address indexed saver, address beneficiary, uint256 amount, uint256 credits);
    event SavingsDeposited(address indexed saver, uint256 amount, uint256 credits);
    event CreditsRedeemed(address indexed redeemer, uint256 credits, uint256 amount);
    event ExchangeRateUpdated(uint256 newRate, uint256 oldRate);
    event ConnectorUpdated(address connector);
    event PokerUpdated(address poker);
    event FractionUpdated(uint256 fraction);
    event Poked(uint256 newBalance, uint256 interestCollected, uint256 newExchangeRate);
    event PokedRaw();
    event EmergencyUpdate();

        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[msg.sender][spender];

        }

    function deposit(uint256 _amount, address _beneficiary) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        require(_beneficiary != address(0), "Invalid beneficiary address");
        
        if (automateInterestCollection) {

        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");

        require(_recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient");
        
        uint256 amount = _convertFromCredits(_credits);
        _burn(msg.sender, _credits);
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(_recipient, amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, _credits, amount);
        emit Withdraw(MUSD, msg.sender, _beneficiary, amount, _credits);
    }

    function redeemCredits(uint256 _credits) external {
        require(_credits > 0, "Must redeem something");
        
        uint256 amount = _convertFromCredits(_credits);
        _burn(msg.sender, _credits);
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, _credits, amount);
    }

    function redeemAndUnwrap(
        uint256 _credits,
        bool _isToken,
        uint256 _minAmountOut,
        address _output,
        address _beneficiary,
        address _router,
        bool /* unused */
    ) external {
        require(_credits > 0, "Must redeem something");
        require(_output != address(0), "Output address is zero");
        require(_beneficiary != address(0), "Beneficiary address is zero");
        require(_router != address(0), "Router address is zero");
        
        if (automateInterestCollection) {
            ISavingsManager(SAVINGS_MANAGER).collectAndDistributeInterest(MUSD);
        }
        
        uint256 amount = _convertFromCredits(_credits);
        _burn(msg.sender, _credits);
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeApprove(unwrapper, amount);
        IUnwrapper(unwrapper).unwrapAndSend(_isToken, _beneficiary, _output, _router, amount, _minAmountOut, _router);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, _credits, amount);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 _amount) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= credits, "Amount exceeds balance");
        
        _burn(msg.sender, credits);
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, credits, _amount);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 _amount, address _recipient, address _beneficiary) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        require(_recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient");
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= credits, "Amount exceeds balance");
        
        _burn(msg.sender, credits);
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(_recipient, _amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, credits, _amount);
        emit Withdraw(MUSD, msg.sender, _beneficiary, _amount, credits);
    }

    function redeemUnderlying(uint256 _amount) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= credits, "Amount exceeds balance");
        
        _burn(msg.sender, credits);
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, credits, _amount);
    }

        emit EmergencyUpdate();

        _poke();
    }

        uint256 balance = IERC20(MUSD).balanceOf(address(this));

        if (newExchangeRate > exchangeRate) {
            exchangeRate = newExchangeRate;
            emit ExchangeRateUpdated(newExchangeRate, exchangeRate);

        lastPokeBalance = balance;
        
        emit Poked(balance, 0, newExchangeRate);
    }

        if (_totalSupply == 0) return 1e18;
        return (balance * 1e18) / _totalSupply;

        return (_amount * 1e18) / exchangeRate;

        return (_credits * exchangeRate) / 1e18;

        return _convertToCredits(_amount);
    }

    function previewMint(uint256 _shares) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_shares);
    }

    function previewWithdraw(uint256 _shares) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_shares);
    }

    function previewRedeem(uint256 _shares) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_shares);
    }

        return _balances[_owner];
    }

    function balanceOfUnderlying(address _owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_balances[_owner]);
    }

    function creditBalances(address _owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[_owner];
    }

    function underlyingToCredits(uint256 _amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertToCredits(_amount);
    }

    function creditsToUnderlying(uint256 _credits) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_credits);
    }

    function asset() external view returns (address) {
        return MUSD;
    }

    function lastBalance() external view returns (uint256) {
        return IERC20(MUSD).balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function setConnector(address _connector) external onlyGovernor {
        connector = _connector;
        emit ConnectorUpdated(_connector);
    }

    function setPoker(address _poker) external onlyGovernor {
        _setPoker(_poker);
    }

    function _setPoker(address _poker) internal {
        require(_poker != address(0) || _getPoker() == _poker, "Invalid poker address");
        // Store poker in slot 0x3a
        assembly {
            sstore(0x3a, or(and(sload(0x3a), 0xffffffffffffffffffffffff00000000000000000000000000000000), _poker))
        }
        emit PokerUpdated(_poker);
    }

    function _getPoker() internal view returns (address poker_) {
        assembly {
            poker_ := and(sload(0x3a), 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff)
        }
    }

    function poker() external view returns (address) {
        return _getPoker();
    }

    function setFraction(uint256 _fraction) external onlyPoker {
        require(_fraction <= 50e16, "Fraction must be <= 50%");
        fraction = _fraction;
        emit FractionUpdated(_fraction);
    }

    function automateInterestCollectionFlag(bool _enabled) external onlyPoker {
        automateInterestCollection = _enabled;
        emit AutomaticInterestCollectionSwitched(_enabled);
    }

    function governor() external view returns (address) {
        return INexus(nexus).governor();
    }

    function mint(uint256 _amount, address _recipient) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        require(_recipient != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        
        if (automateInterestCollection) {
            ISavingsManager(SAVINGS_MANAGER).collectAndDistributeInterest(MUSD);
        }
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        _mint(_recipient, credits);
        
        emit Deposit(MUSD, _recipient, _amount, credits);
    }

    function mint(uint256 _amount, address _recipient, address _referrer) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        require(_recipient != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        
        if (automateInterestCollection) {
            ISavingsManager(SAVINGS_MANAGER).collectAndDistributeInterest(MUSD);
        }
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        _mint(_recipient, credits);
        
        emit Deposit(MUSD, _recipient, _amount, credits);
        
        if (_referrer != address(0)) {
            emit Referral(_referrer, _recipient, _amount);
        }
    }
}

        return _getStorageUint(0x03);

        _setStorageUint(0x16, totalSupply + count);

        _setStorageBytes32(0x12, communityRoot_);
        _setStorageBytes32(0x13, gcfRoot_);
        
        _setOwner(msg.sender);
        _grantRole(_OPERATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);
        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    function _setStorageString(uint256 slot, string memory str) internal {
        uint256 len = bytes(str).length;
        _setStorageUint(slot, (len << 1) | 1);
        
        if (len > 0) {
            uint256 dataSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(slot)));
            bytes memory data = bytes(str);
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i += 32) {
                uint256 chunk;
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < 32 && i + j < len; j++) {
                    chunk |= uint256(uint8(data[i + j])) << (248 - j * 8);
                }
                _setStorageUint(dataSlot + i / 32, chunk);
            }
        }
    }
}

        uint amount0 = balance0 - _reserve0;
        uint amount1 = balance1 - _reserve1;

        bool feeOn = _mintFee(_reserve0, _reserve1);
        uint _totalSupply = totalSupply;
        if (_totalSupply == 0) {
            liquidity = Math.sqrt(amount0 * amount1) - MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY;
            _mint(address(0), MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY);

        reserve1 = uint112(balance1);
        blockTimestampLast = blockTimestamp;
        emit Sync(reserve0, reserve1);
    }

        _update(IERC20(token0).balanceOf(address(this)), IERC20(token1).balanceOf(address(this)), reserve0, reserve1);

        return _locked1;
    }

        require(_reserve0 > 0 && _reserve1 > 0, 'KingSwap: INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY');
        uint reserveIn = token == token0 ? _reserve0 : _reserve1;
        uint reserveOut = token == token0 ? _reserve1 : _reserve0;
        uint amountOut = amountIn * 997 * reserveOut / (reserveIn * 1000 + amountIn * 997);
        return amountOut;

        return getAmountInPool(token, amountOut);

        return 1;

contract Token is IERC20, Ownable {

    string private constant _symbol = "TKN";
    uint8 private constant _decimals = 9;

    uint256 private constant MAX = ~uint256(0);
    uint256 private _tTotal = 1_000_000 * 10 ** _decimals;
    uint256 private _rTotal = (MAX - (MAX % _tTotal));
    uint256 private _tFeeTotal;

    address public uniswapV2Pair;

    uint256 private _buyTaxFee = 0;
    uint256 private _buyLiquidityFee = 0;

    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromReward;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromMaxTx;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromMaxWallet;
    mapping(address => bool) private _automatedMarketMakerPairs;

        _isExcludedFromFee[msg.sender] = true;

    function name() public pure returns (string memory) {

    function balanceOf(address account) public view override returns (uint256) {

        return true;

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[sender][msg.sender];
        require(currentAllowance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance");
        _approve(sender, msg.sender, currentAllowance - amount);
        return true;
    }

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + addedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[msg.sender][spender];
        require(currentAllowance >= subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function isExcludedFromReward(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isExcludedFromReward[account];
    }

    function totalFees() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _tFeeTotal;
    }

    function tokenFromReflection(uint256 rAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(rAmount <= _rTotal, "Amount must be less than total reflections");
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        return rAmount / currentRate;
    }

    function reflectionFromToken(uint256 tAmount, bool deductTransferFee) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(tAmount <= _tTotal, "Amount must be less than supply");
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        if (!deductTransferFee) {
            return tAmount * currentRate;
        } else {
            uint256 rAmount = tAmount * currentRate;
            uint256 rTransferAmount = rAmount - (tAmount * _transferTaxFee / 100 * currentRate);
            return rTransferAmount;
        }
    }

    function excludeFromReward(address account) public onlyOwner {
        require(!_isExcludedFromReward[account], "Account is already excluded");
        if (_rOwned[account] > 0) {
            _tOwned[account] = tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account]);
        }
        _isExcludedFromReward[account] = true;
        _excludedArr.push(account);

    function includeInReward(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(_isExcludedFromReward[account], "Account is not excluded");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excludedArr.length; i++) {
            if (_excludedArr[i] == account) {
                _excludedArr[i] = _excludedArr[_excludedArr.length - 1];
                _tOwned[account] = 0;
                _isExcludedFromReward[account] = false;
                _excludedArr.pop();

        require(recipient != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "Transfer amount must be greater than zero");

        uint256 taxFee;
        uint256 liquidityFee;
        uint256 marketingFee;
        uint256 burnFee;

        if (sender != owner() && recipient != owner()) {
            if (!_tradingOpen) {
                require(_isExcludedFromFee[sender] || _isExcludedFromFee[recipient], "Trading not yet enabled");
            }

            if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[sender] && !_isExcludedFromMaxTx[recipient]) {
                require(amount <= _maxTxAmount, "Transfer amount exceeds the maxTxAmount");
                uint256 contractBalanceRefl = balanceOf(address(this));
                if (contractBalanceRefl > 0) {}
            }

            if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[recipient] && !_isExcludedFromMaxTx[sender]) {
                require(amount <= _maxTxAmount, "Transfer amount exceeds the maxTxAmount");
            }

            if (!_automatedMarketMakerPairs[recipient] && !_isExcludedFromMaxWallet[recipient]) {
                require(balanceOf(recipient) + amount <= _maxWalletSize, "Max wallet size exceeded");

            if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[sender]) {
                taxFee = _buyTaxFee;
                liquidityFee = _buyLiquidityFee;
                marketingFee = _buyMarketingFee;
                burnFee = _buyBurnFee;
            } else if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[recipient]) {
                taxFee = _sellTaxFee;
                liquidityFee = _sellLiquidityFee;
                marketingFee = _sellMarketingFee;
                burnFee = _sellBurnFee;
            } else {
                taxFee = _transferTaxFee;
                liquidityFee = _transferLiquidityFee;
                marketingFee = _transferMarketingFee;
                burnFee = _transferBurnFee;
            }
        }

        _tokenTransfer(sender, recipient, amount, taxFee, liquidityFee, marketingFee, burnFee);
    }

    function _tokenTransfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 taxFee, uint256 liquidityFee, uint256 marketingFee, uint256 burnFee) private {
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        uint256 rAmount = amount * currentRate;
        uint256 rTaxFee = (amount * taxFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rLiquidityFee = (amount * liquidityFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rMarketingFee = (amount * marketingFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rBurnFee = (amount * burnFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rTransferAmount = rAmount - rTaxFee - rLiquidityFee - rMarketingFee - rBurnFee;

        if (_isExcludedFromReward[sender]) {
            _tOwned[sender] -= amount;
        }
        if (_isExcludedFromReward[recipient]) {
            _tOwned[recipient] += amount - (amount * (taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee) / 100);
        }

        _rOwned[sender] -= rAmount;
        _rOwned[recipient] += rTransferAmount;

        if (taxFee > 0) {
            _rTotal -= rTaxFee;
            _tFeeTotal += amount * taxFee / 100;
        }
        if (liquidityFee > 0) {
            _rOwned[address(this)] += rLiquidityFee;
        }
        if (marketingFee > 0) {
            _rOwned[_marketingWallet] += rMarketingFee;
        }
        if (burnFee > 0) {
            _rTotal -= rBurnFee;
            _tTotal -= amount * burnFee / 100;
        }

        emit Transfer(sender, recipient, amount - (amount * (taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee) / 100));
    }

    function _getRate() private view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 rSupply = _rTotal;
        uint256 tSupply = _tTotal;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excludedArr.length; i++) {
            if (_rOwned[_excludedArr[i]] > rSupply || _tOwned[_excludedArr[i]] > tSupply) return _rTotal / _tTotal;
            rSupply -= _rOwned[_excludedArr[i]];
            tSupply -= _tOwned[_excludedArr[i]];
        }
        if (rSupply < _rTotal / _tTotal) return _rTotal / _tTotal;
        return rSupply / tSupply;
    }

    function _getValues(uint256 tAmount) private view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 tTransferAmount = tAmount - (tAmount * _transferTaxFee / 100);
        uint256 rAmount = tAmount * _getRate();
        uint256 rTransferAmount = rAmount - (tAmount * _transferTaxFee / 100 * _getRate());
        return (rAmount, rTransferAmount, tTransferAmount);
    }

    function _reflectFee(uint256 rFee, uint256 tFee) private {
        _rTotal -= rFee;
        _tFeeTotal += tFee;
    }

    function _takeLiquidity(uint256 tLiquidity) private {
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        uint256 rLiquidity = tLiquidity * currentRate;
        _rOwned[address(this)] += rLiquidity;
        if (_isExcludedFromReward[address(this)]) {
            _tOwned[address(this)] += tLiquidity;
        }
    }

        receiver = ownerOf(tokenId);
        uint256 royaltyBps = _royaltyBps[receiver];
        require(salePrice <= 10000, "ERC2981: royalty fee will exceed salePrice");
        require(receiver != address(0), "ERC2981: Invalid parameters");
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * royaltyBps) / 10000;

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + value % 10));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    function _msgSender() internal view virtual returns (address) {
        return msg.sender;
    }
}

abstract contract ERC20 is Context, IERC20, IERC20Metadata {
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;
    uint256 private _totalSupply;
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;

    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_) {
        _name = name_;
        _symbol = symbol_;
    }

    function name() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    }

        return _totalSupply;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[sender][_msgSender()];
        require(currentAllowance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance");

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public virtual returns (bool) {
        _approve(_msgSender(), spender, _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public virtual returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[_msgSender()][spender];
        require(currentAllowance >= subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        unchecked {
            _approve(_msgSender(), spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue);
        }
        return true;
    }

    function _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(sender != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(recipient != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");
        uint256 senderBalance = _balances[sender];
        require(senderBalance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked {
            _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount;

        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[account] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), account, amount);
    }

        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");

    }

        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");

    mapping(address => uint256) private _nonces;
    bytes32 private constant _PERMIT_TYPEHASH = keccak256("Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)");
    bytes32 private immutable _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;

    constructor() {

            keccak256(bytes("1")),

    function permit(address owner, address spender, uint256 value, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) public virtual override {
        require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "ERC20Permit: expired deadline");
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(_PERMIT_TYPEHASH, owner, spender, value, _useNonce(owner), deadline));
        bytes32 hash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, structHash));
        address signer = ECDSA.recover(hash, v, r, s);
        require(signer == owner, "ERC20Permit: invalid signature");
        _approve(owner, spender, value);
    }

    function nonces(address owner) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _nonces[owner];
    }

    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view virtual override returns (bytes32) {
        return _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;
    }

    function _useNonce(address owner) internal virtual returns (uint256 current) {
        current = _nonces[owner];
        _nonces[owner]++;
    }

library ECDSA {
    function recover(bytes32 hash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal pure returns (address) {
        require(uint256(s) <= 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF5D576E7357A4501DDFE92F46681B20A0, "ECDSA: invalid signature 's' value");

        address signer = ecrecover(hash, v, r, s);
        require(signer != address(0), "ECDSA: invalid signature");
        return signer;
    }
}

    event Unpaused(address account);

        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        require(paused(), "Pausable: not paused");
        _;
    }

    function _pause() internal virtual whenNotPaused {
        _paused = true;

        _checkRole(role, _msgSender());
        _;
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view virtual override returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view virtual {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            revert(string(abi.encodePacked("AccessControl: account ", Strings.toHexString(account), " is missing role ", Strings.toHexString(uint256(role), 32))));
        }
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view virtual override returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual override onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual override onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual override {
        require(account == _msgSender(), "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _setupRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal virtual {
        bytes32 previousAdminRole = getRoleAdmin(role);
        _roles[role].adminRole = adminRole;
        emit RoleAdminChanged(role, previousAdminRole, adminRole);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, _msgSender());
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual {
        if (hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, _msgSender());
        }
    }
}

library Strings {
    bytes16 private constant _HEX_SYMBOLS = "0123456789abcdef";
    uint8 private constant _ADDRESS_LENGTH = 20;

    function toHexString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0x00";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 length = 0;
        while (temp != 0) {
            length++;
            temp >>= 8;
        }
        return toHexString(value, length);
    }

    function toHexString(uint256 value, uint256 length) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(2 * length + 2);
        buffer[0] = "0";
        buffer[1] = "x";
        for (uint256 i = 2 * length + 1; i > 1; --i) {
            buffer[i] = _HEX_SYMBOLS[value & 0xf];
            value >>= 4;
        }
        require(value == 0, "Strings: hex length insufficient");
        return string(buffer);
    }

    function toHexString(address addr) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        return toHexString(uint256(uint160(addr)), _ADDRESS_LENGTH);
    }
}

    function allPendingRewards(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 total = userBaseClaimable[user];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokensArray.length; i++) {
            address token = registeredTokensArray[i];
            PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
            UserInfo storage userInfo_ = userInfoMap[token][user];

            uint256 accRewardPerShare = pool.accRewardPerShare;
            uint256 totalSupply = pool.totalSupply;

            if (block.timestamp > pool.lastRewardTime && totalSupply > 0) {
                uint256 reward = (block.timestamp - pool.lastRewardTime) * getRewardsPerSecond() * pool.allocPoint / totalAllocPoint();
                accRewardPerShare += reward * 1e12 / totalSupply;
            }

            total += userInfo_.amount * accRewardPerShare / 1e12 - userInfo_.rewardDebt;
        }
        return total;
    }

    function updatePool(address token) public {
        PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
        if (block.timestamp <= pool.lastRewardTime) {
            return;
        }

        uint256 totalSupply = pool.totalSupply;
        if (totalSupply == 0) {
            pool.lastRewardTime = block.timestamp;
            return;
        }

        uint256 reward = (block.timestamp - pool.lastRewardTime) * getRewardsPerSecond() * pool.allocPoint / totalAllocPoint();
        pool.accRewardPerShare += reward * 1e12 / totalSupply;
        pool.lastRewardTime = block.timestamp;
    }

    function massUpdatePools() public {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokensArray.length; i++) {
            updatePool(registeredTokensArray[i]);
        }
    }

    function beforeLockUpdate(address user) external onlyWhitelisted {
        _updateAllPools(user);
    }

    function afterLockUpdate(address user) external onlyWhitelisted {
        _claimAll(user);
    }

    function handleActionBefore(address user) external onlyWhitelisted {
        _updateAllPools(user);
    }

    function handleActionAfter(address user, uint256 amount, uint256 totalSupply) external onlyWhitelisted {
        _handleAction(user, amount, totalSupply);
    }

    function _updateAllPools(address user) internal {
        uint256 baseClaimable = userBaseClaimable[user];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokensArray.length; i++) {
            address token = registeredTokensArray[i];
            PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
            UserInfo storage userInfo_ = userInfoMap[token][user];

            updatePool(token);

            if (userInfo_.amount > 0) {
                uint256 pending = userInfo_.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12 - userInfo_.rewardDebt;
                baseClaimable += pending;
            }
        }
        userBaseClaimable[user] = baseClaimable;
        lastAllPoolUpdate = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _handleAction(address user, uint256 amount, uint256 totalSupply) internal {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokensArray.length; i++) {
            address token = registeredTokensArray[i];
            PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
            UserInfo storage userInfo_ = userInfoMap[token][user];

            updatePool(token);

            if (userInfo_.amount > 0) {
                uint256 pending = userInfo_.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12 - userInfo_.rewardDebt;
                userBaseClaimable[user] += pending;
            }

            userInfo_.amount = amount;
            userInfo_.rewardDebt = amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12;

            if (pool.rewardTracker != address(0)) {
                IRewardTracker(pool.rewardTracker).handleAction(user, amount, totalSupply);
            }
        }
    }

    function claim(address user, address[] calldata tokens) external onlyWhitelisted {
        _claim(user, tokens);
    }

    function _claim(address user, address[] calldata tokens) internal {
        uint256 totalPending = userBaseClaimable[user];

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = tokens[i];
            PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
            UserInfo storage userInfo_ = userInfoMap[token][user];

            updatePool(token);

            uint256 pending = userInfo_.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12 - userInfo_.rewardDebt;
            totalPending += pending;

            userInfo_.rewardDebt = userInfo_.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12;
        }

        userBaseClaimable[user] = 0;
        _transferReward(user, totalPending);
    }

    function claimAll(address user) external onlyWhitelisted {
        _claimAll(user);
    }

    function _claimAll(address user) internal {
        _claim(user, registeredTokensArray);
    }

    function claimBounty(address user, bool dq) external onlyBountyManager {
        if (dq) {
            _disqualify(user);
        } else {
            _claimAll(user);
        }
    }

    function _disqualify(address user) internal {
        uint256 totalPending = userBaseClaimable[user];

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokensArray.length; i++) {
            address token = registeredTokensArray[i];
            PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
            UserInfo storage userInfo_ = userInfoMap[token][user];

            updatePool(token);

            uint256 pending = userInfo_.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12 - userInfo_.rewardDebt;
            totalPending += pending;

            userInfo_.amount = 0;
            userInfo_.rewardDebt = 0;
        }

        userBaseClaimable[user] = 0;
        emit Disqualified(user);
    }

    function _transferReward(address user, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount > 0) {
            IERC20(address(rdntToken)).transfer(user, amount);
        }
    }

    function batchUpdateAllocPoint(address[] calldata tokens, uint256[] calldata allocPoints) external onlyPoolConfigurator {
        require(tokens.length == allocPoints.length, "Length mismatch");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            poolInfo[tokens[i]].allocPoint = allocPoints[i];
        }
    }

    function getUserInfo(address token, address user) external view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, address) {
        UserInfo storage info = userInfoMap[token][user];
        return (info.amount, info.rewardDebt, info.lastClaimTime, info.user);
    }

    function endRewardTime() external view returns (uint256) {
        return endingTime;
    }

    function isWhitelistActive() external view returns (bool) {
        return whitelistActiveBool;
    }

    function getEligibilityExempt(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return eligibilityExemptMap[user];
    }

    function getEmissionSchedule(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        return (emissionScheduleArray[index].startTime, emissionScheduleArray[index].rewardsPerSecond);
    }

    function getRegisteredToken(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return registeredTokensArray[index];
    }

    function getWhitelist(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return whitelistMap[user];
    }

    function mfd() external view returns (address) {
        return address(mfdContract);
    }

    function bountyManager() external view returns (address) {
        return address(bountyManagerContract);
    }

    function getLastRPS() external view returns (uint256) {
        return lastRPS;
    }

    function getAccountedRewards() external view returns (uint256) {
        return accountedRewards;
    }

    function getUserBaseClaimable(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return userBaseClaimable[user];
    }

    function getPoolConfigurator() external view returns (address) {
        return poolConfigurator;
    }

    function getAuthorizedContracts(address contract_) external view returns (bool) {
        return authorizedContracts[contract_];
    }

    function rewardsPerSecond() external view returns (uint256) {
        return getRewardsPerSecond();
    }

    function getDepositedRewards() external view returns (uint256) {
        return depositedRewards;
    }

    function getStartTime() external view returns (uint256) {
        return startTime;
    }

    function getEndingTime() external view returns (uint256) {
        return endingTime;
    }

    function getEligibleDataProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return address(eligibleDataProvider);
    }

    function getLastAllPoolUpdate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return lastAllPoolUpdate;
    }
}

    uint256 private _totalShares;
    uint256 private _totalReleased;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _shares;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _released;
    address[] private _payees;

    event PayeeAdded(address account, uint256 shares);
    event PaymentReleased(address to, uint256 amount);
    event ERC20PaymentReleased(address token, address to, uint256 amount);
    event PaymentReceived(address from, uint256 amount);

    constructor(address[] memory payees, uint256[] memory shares_) payable {
        require(payees.length == shares_.length, "PaymentSplitter: payees and shares length mismatch");
        require(payees.length > 0, "PaymentSplitter: no payees");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < payees.length; i++) {
            _addPayee(payees[i], shares_[i]);
        }

        emit PaymentReceived(msg.sender, msg.value);

        return _released[account];
    }

        return _payees[index];

        uint256 totalReceived = address(this).balance + _totalReleased;
        return _pendingPayment(account, totalReceived, _released[account]);

        require(_shares[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");

        require(payment != 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");
        _released[account] += payment;
        _totalReleased += payment;
        Address.sendValue(account, payment);
        emit PaymentReleased(account, payment);
    }

    function _pendingPayment(address account, uint256 totalReceived, uint256 alreadyReleased) private view returns (uint256) {
        return (totalReceived * _shares[account]) / _totalShares - alreadyReleased;
    }

    function _addPayee(address account, uint256 shares_) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "PaymentSplitter: account is the zero address");
        require(shares_ > 0, "PaymentSplitter: shares are 0");
        require(_shares[account] == 0, "PaymentSplitter: account already has shares");

    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public virtual override {
        _setApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) public view virtual override returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public virtual override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public virtual override {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public virtual override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal virtual {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view virtual returns (bool) {
        return _ownerOf(tokenId) != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view virtual returns (bool) {
        address owner = _ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, spender) || getApproved(tokenId) == spender);
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {
        _safeMint(to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal virtual {
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        require(
            _checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, data),
            "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer"
        );
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        _afterTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _burn(uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {
        address owner = _ownerOf(tokenId);

        _beforeTokenTransfer(owner, address(0), tokenId);

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        _balances[owner] -= 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = address(0);

        emit Transfer(owner, address(0), tokenId);

        _afterTokenTransfer(owner, address(0), tokenId);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {
        require(ERC721.ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);

        _afterTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(ERC721.ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _setApprovalForAll(address owner, address operator, bool approved) internal virtual {
        require(owner != operator, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[owner][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(owner, operator, approved);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.isContract()) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length == 0) {
                    revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
                } else {
                    assembly {
                        revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason))
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {}
    function _afterTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {}
}

contract NFT is ERC721, Ownable, Initializable, PaymentSplitter, IERC2981 {
    using Address for address;

    uint256 private _currentIndex;
    uint256 private _burnCount;
    uint256 private _maxSupply;
    uint256 private _royaltyAmount;
    address private _royaltyReceiver;

    uint8 private _stage;
    uint256 private _price;
    uint256 private _balanceLimit;
    bytes32 private _merkleRoot;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _mintedPerAddress;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isAdmin;

    event RoyaltiesSet(address receiver, uint256 amount);

    constructor(
        string memory name_,
        string memory symbol_,
        address[] memory payees,
        uint256[] memory shares_
    ) ERC721(name_, symbol_) PaymentSplitter(payees, shares_) {
        _royaltyReceiver = msg.sender;
        _royaltyAmount = 500;
    }

    function initialize(
        bytes32 name_,
        bytes32 symbol_,
        bytes32 baseURI_,
        address royaltyReceiver_,
        uint256 royaltyAmount_,
        address[] memory payees_,
        uint256[] memory shares_
    ) external initializer {
        _setName(string(abi.encodePacked(name_)));
        _setSymbol(string(abi.encodePacked(symbol_)));
        _setBaseURI(string(abi.encodePacked(baseURI_)));
        _royaltyReceiver = royaltyReceiver_;
        _royaltyAmount = royaltyAmount_;
        _isAdmin[msg.sender] = true;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < payees_.length; i++) {
            _addPayee(payees_[i], shares_[i]);
        }
    }

    function _setName(string memory newName) internal {
        _name = newName;
    }

    function _setSymbol(string memory newSymbol) internal {
        _symbol = newSymbol;
    }

    function _setBaseURI(string memory newBaseURI) internal {
        _baseTokenURI = newBaseURI;
    }

    function _setSuffix(string memory newSuffix) internal {
        _suffix = newSuffix;
    }

    function _getBaseURI() internal view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseTokenURI;
    }

    function _getSuffix() internal view returns (string memory) {
        return _suffix;
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _currentIndex - _burnCount;
    }

    function maxSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxSupply;
    }

    function stage() public view returns (uint8) {
        return _stage;
    }

    function price(uint8) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _price;
    }

    function balanceLimit(uint8) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _balanceLimit;
    }

    function merkleTreeRoot(uint8) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _merkleRoot;
    }

    function setStage(uint8 stage_) external onlyOwner {
        _stage = stage_;
    }

    function setPrice(uint8, uint256 price_) external onlyOwner {
        _price = price_;
    }

    function updateBalanceLimit(uint8, uint256 limit_) external onlyOwner {
        _balanceLimit = limit_;
    }

    function updateMerkleTreeRoot(uint8, bytes32 root_) external onlyOwner {
        _merkleRoot = root_;
    }

    function setMaxSupply(uint256 maxSupply_) external onlyOwner {
        _maxSupply = maxSupply_;
    }

    function setRoyalties(address receiver, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _royaltyReceiver = receiver;
        _royaltyAmount = amount;
        emit RoyaltiesSet(receiver, amount);
    }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256, uint256 salePrice) external view override returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
        receiver = _royaltyReceiver;
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * _royaltyAmount) / 10000;
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view override(ERC721, IERC165) returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == type(IERC2981).interfaceId || super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);
    }

    function setAdminPermissions(address account, bool isAdmin_) external onlyOwner {
        _isAdmin[account] = isAdmin_;
    }

    function isAdmin(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isAdmin[account];
    }

    function addToWhitelist(uint8, address[] memory accounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _mintedPerAddress[accounts[i]] = 0;
        }
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(uint8, address[] memory accounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _mintedPerAddress[accounts[i]] = 0;
        }
    }

    function isWhitelisted(uint8, address account, bytes32[] memory proof) public view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account));
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            leaf = proof[i] < leaf ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(proof[i], leaf)) : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(leaf, proof[i]));
        }
        return leaf == _merkleRoot;
    }

    function publicMint(uint256 quantity) external payable {
        require(_stage == 1, "Current stage is not enabled");
        require(quantity <= _balanceLimit, "Exceeds balance limit");
        require(msg.value >= _price * quantity, "Insufficient payment");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "No bots");
        _mintLoop(quantity, msg.sender);
    }

    function multiStageMint(uint256 quantity, bytes32[] memory proof, uint8 stage_) external payable {
        require(_stage == stage_, "Current stage is not enabled");
        require(quantity <= _balanceLimit, "Exceeds balance limit");
        require(isWhitelisted(stage_, msg.sender, proof), "Not whitelisted");
        require(msg.value >= _price * quantity, "Insufficient payment");
        _mintLoop(quantity, msg.sender);
    }

    function adminMint(address[] memory to, uint256[] memory quantities) external {
        require(_isAdmin[msg.sender], "Admin mint: bad request");
        require(to.length == quantities.length, "Arrays length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < to.length; i++) {
            _mintLoop(quantities[i], to[i]);
        }
    }

    function _mintLoop(uint256 quantity, address to) internal {
        require(totalSupply() + quantity <= _maxSupply, "Exceeds max supply");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _currentIndex + i;
            _safeMint(to, tokenId);
            _mintedPerAddress[to]++;
        }
        _currentIndex += quantity;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address owner) {
        return ownerOf(tokenId);
    }

    function explicitOwnershipsOf(uint256[] memory tokenIds) external view returns (address[] memory owners) {
        owners = new address[](tokenIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            owners[i] = ownerOf(tokenIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function tokensOfOwner(address owner) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 balance = balanceOf(owner);
        uint256[] memory tokens = new uint256[](balance);
        uint256 index = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _currentIndex; i++) {
            if (_ownerOf(i) == owner) {
                tokens[index++] = i;
            }
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function tokensOfOwnerIn(address owner, uint256 start, uint256 end) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory tokens = new uint256[](balanceOf(owner));
        uint256 index = 0;
        for (uint256 i = start; i < end && i < _currentIndex; i++) {
            if (_ownerOf(i) == owner) {
                tokens[index++] = i;
            }
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function setPrefix(string memory prefix_) external onlyOwner {
        _setBaseURI(prefix_);
    }

    function setSuffix(string memory suffix_) external onlyOwner {
        _setSuffix(suffix_);
    }

    function prefix() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _getBaseURI();
    }

    function suffix() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _getSuffix();
    }

    function remainingBalance(uint8, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balanceLimit - _mintedPerAddress[account];
    }

    function currentBalance(uint8, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _mintedPerAddress[account];
    }
}

        address _reserve,

            require(ILendingPoolCore(core).isUserAllowedToBorrowAtStable(_reserve, msg.sender), ERROR_BORROW_STABLE_NOT_ALLOWED);
            
            currentStableRate = ILendingPoolCore(core).getUserCurrentStableBorrowRate(_reserve, msg.sender);
            borrowRate = currentStableRate;

            // Variable rate

            borrowRate = currentVariableRate;

        originationFee = ILendingPoolCore(core).calculateLoanOriginationFee(_reserve, _amount);
        
        ILendingPoolCore(core).updateStateOnBorrow(
            _reserve, 
            msg.sender, 
            _amount, 
            borrowRate, 
            originationFee, 
            uint8(_interestRateMode)
        );
        
        emit Borrow(
            _reserve, 
            msg.sender, 
            _amount, 
            _interestRateMode, 
            borrowRate, 
            originationFee, 
            borrowBalanceIncrease, 
            _referralCode, 
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function _repay(
        address _reserve,
        uint256 _amount,
        address _onBehalfOf
    ) internal {
        require(_amount > 0, ERROR_AMOUNT_ZERO);
        _checkReserveActive(_reserve);
        
        (uint256 stableDebt, uint256 variableDebt, , , , , , ) = ILendingPoolCore(core).getUserReserveData(_reserve, _onBehalfOf);
        uint256 totalDebt = stableDebt.add(variableDebt);
        require(totalDebt > 0, ERROR_NO_BORROW);

        ILendingPoolCore(core).updateStateOnRepay(_reserve, _onBehalfOf, amountToRepay, 0, 0, false);

        (uint256 stableDebt, uint256 variableDebt, , , , , , ) = ILendingPoolCore(core).getUserReserveData(_reserve, msg.sender);
        require(stableDebt > 0 || variableDebt > 0, ERROR_NO_BORROW);
        
        uint256 currentRateMode = 0;
        uint256 newRateMode = 0;
        uint256 newRate = 0;
        uint256 borrowBalanceIncrease = 0;

            newRate = ILendingPoolCore(core).getReserveCurrentVariableBorrowRate(_reserve);

    function _checkOracleSlippage(bytes calldata data, uint24 fee, uint32 secondsAgo) internal view {

            int56 tickCumulativeDelta = tickCumulatives[1] - tickCumulatives[0];
            int24 tick = int24(tickCumulativeDelta / int56(int32(secondsAgo)));

        } catch {
            revert InvalidSwap();

    function sweepToken(address token, uint256 amountMinimum, address recipient) public payable {

    function sweepTokenWithFee(address token, uint256 amountMinimum, address recipient, uint256 feeBips, address feeRecipient) public payable {
        uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 fee = (balance * feeBips) / 10000;
        _transfer(token, feeRecipient, fee);
        _transfer(token, recipient, balance - fee);
    }

    function sweepToken(address token, uint256 amountMinimum) external payable {
        sweepToken(token, amountMinimum, msg.sender);

    function sweepTokenWithFee(address token, uint256 amountMinimum, uint256 feeBips, address feeRecipient) external payable {

    }

    function unwrapWETH9(uint256 amountMinimum, address recipient) public payable {
        uint256 balance = IWETH9(WETH9).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (balance < amountMinimum) revert InsufficientETH();
        if (balance > 0) IWETH9(WETH9).withdraw(balance);
        _transferETH(recipient, balance);
    }

    function unwrapWETH9WithFee(uint256 amountMinimum, address recipient, uint256 feeBips, address feeRecipient) public payable {
        uint256 balance = IWETH9(WETH9).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (balance < amountMinimum) revert InsufficientETH();
        uint256 fee = (balance * feeBips) / 10000;
        if (balance > 0) IWETH9(WETH9).withdraw(balance);
        _transferETH(feeRecipient, fee);
        _transferETH(recipient, balance - fee);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
            (bool success, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(data[i]);
            if (!success) {
                if (result.length < 68) revert InvalidSwap();
                assembly {
                    result := add(result, 0x04)
                }
                revert(abi.decode(result, (string)));

            results[i] = result;

            IERC20Permit(token).permit(msg.sender, address(this), value, deadline, v, r, s);
        }
    }

    function selfPermitAllowed(address token, uint256 nonce, uint256 expiry, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external payable {
        IERC20Permit(token).permit(msg.sender, address(this), type(uint256).max, expiry, v, r, s);
    }

    function selfPermitAllowedIfNecessary(address token, uint256 nonce, uint256 expiry, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external payable {
        if (IERC20(token).allowance(msg.sender, address(this)) < type(uint256).max) {
            IERC20Permit(token).permit(msg.sender, address(this), type(uint256).max, expiry, v, r, s);
        }
    }

    function approveMax(address token) external payable {
        _approve(token, type(uint256).max);

    function approveMaxMinusOne(address token) external payable {
        _approve(token, type(uint256).max - 1);

    function approveZeroThenMax(address token) external payable {
        _approve(token, 0);
        _approve(token, type(uint256).max);
    }

    function approveZeroThenMaxMinusOne(address token) external payable {
        _approve(token, 0);
        _approve(token, type(uint256).max - 1);
    }

    function getApprovalType(address token, uint256 amount) external payable returns (uint8) {
        uint256 allowance = IERC20(token).allowance(msg.sender, address(this));
        if (allowance < amount) {
            if (allowance == type(uint256).max - 1) return 4;
            if (allowance == type(uint256).max) return 3;
            if (allowance == 0) return 1;
            return 2;

        amountOut = _exactInput(params);
    }

        amountIn = _exactOutput(params);
    }

    function swapTokensForExactTokens(uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMax, address[] calldata path, address to) external payable returns (uint256[] memory amounts) {
        amounts = IUniswapV2Router(factoryV2).swapTokensForExactTokens(amountOut, amountInMax, path, to);
    }

    function swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] calldata path, address to) external payable returns (uint256[] memory amounts) {
        amounts = IUniswapV2Router(factoryV2).swapExactTokensForTokens(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to);
    }

        (liquidity, amount0, amount1) = _increaseLiquidity(params);
    }

    function callPositionManager(bytes calldata data) external payable returns (bytes memory result) {
        (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = positionManager.call{value: msg.value}(data);
        if (!success) {
            if (returnData.length < 68) revert InvalidSwap();
            assembly {
                returnData := add(returnData, 0x04)
            }
            revert(abi.decode(returnData, (string)));
        }
        return returnData;
    }

    function uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta, bytes calldata data) external override {
        _swapCallback(amount0Delta, amount1Delta, data);
    }

    function uniswapV3MintCallback(uint256 amount0Owed, uint256 amount1Owed, bytes calldata data) external override {
        _mintCallback(amount0Owed, amount1Owed, data);
    }

    function _swapCallback(int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta, bytes calldata data) internal {
        uint256 amountToPay = amount0Delta > 0 ? uint256(amount0Delta) : uint256(amount1Delta);
        address token = amount0Delta > 0 ? IUniswapV3Pool(msg.sender).token0() : IUniswapV3Pool(msg.sender).token1();
        (address payer, address recipient) = _decodePayerRecipient(data);

            _pay(token, recipient, amountToPay);
        }

    function _mintCallback(uint256 amount0Owed, uint256 amount1Owed, bytes calldata data) internal {

        address token1 = IUniswapV3Pool(msg.sender).token1();
        (address payer, ) = _decodePayerRecipient(data);
        if (payer == address(0)) {
            _pay(token0, msg.sender, amount0Owed);
            _pay(token1, msg.sender, amount1Owed);
        } else {
            _transferFrom(token0, payer, address(this), amount0Owed);
            _pay(token0, msg.sender, amount0Owed);
            _transferFrom(token1, payer, address(this), amount1Owed);
            _pay(token1, msg.sender, amount1Owed);

        amountIn = uint256(amount0Delta);
    }

    function _exactInput(ExactInputParams calldata params) internal returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        address tokenIn = params.tokenIn;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < params.path.length - 1; i++) {
            (address tokenOut, uint24 fee) = _decodePool(params.path[i]);
            address pool = _getPool(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee);
            (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = _swap(pool, address(this), int256(params.amountIn), 0, true);
            amountOut = uint256(-amount1Delta);
            tokenIn = tokenOut;
        }
        _transfer(tokenIn, params.recipient, amountOut);
    }

    function _exactOutput(ExactOutputParams calldata params) internal returns (uint256 amountIn) {
        address tokenOut = params.tokenOut;
        for (uint256 i = params.path.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            (address tokenIn, uint24 fee) = _decodePool(params.path[i]);
            address pool = _getPool(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee);
            (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = _swap(pool, address(this), -int256(params.amountOut), 0, false);
            amountIn = uint256(amount0Delta);
            tokenOut = tokenIn;
        }
        _transferFrom(tokenOut, msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
    }

    function _swap(address pool, address recipient, int256 amountSpecified, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96, bool exactInput) internal returns (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) {
        (amount0Delta, amount1Delta) = IUniswapV3Pool(pool).swap(recipient, amountSpecified, sqrtPriceLimitX96, exactInput, "");
    }

        (tokenId, liquidity, amount0, amount1) = IPositionManager(positionManager).mint(
            params.token0,

            params.recipient,

    }

    function _increaseLiquidity(IncreaseLiquidityParams calldata params) internal returns (uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
        (liquidity, amount0, amount1) = IPositionManager(positionManager).increaseLiquidity(
            params.tokenId,
            params.amount0Desired,
            params.amount1Desired,
            params.amount0Min,
            params.amount1Min,
            params.deadline
        );
    }

    function _getPool(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint24 fee) internal view returns (address pool) {
        (address token0, address token1) = tokenA < tokenB ? (tokenA, tokenB) : (tokenB, tokenA);
        bytes32 salt = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(token0, token1, fee));
        assembly {
            pool := shr(96, mod(keccak256(add(0x60, salt), 0x55), 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF))
        }

        assembly {
            tokenOut := shr(96, calldataload(data.offset))
            fee := and(calldataload(add(data.offset, 0x14)), 0xffffff)
        }
    }
