    function _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(address operator, address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) private {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155BatchReceived(operator, from, ids, amounts, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155BatchReceived.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {
                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }
        }
    }

    // Minting and Burning
    function _mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        _totalSupply[id] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _mintBatch(address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            _balances[ids[i]][to] += amounts[i];
            _totalSupply[ids[i]] += amounts[i];
        }
        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, address(0), to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, address(0), to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC1155: burn from the zero address");
        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
        _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
        _totalSupply[id] -= amount;
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, from, address(0), id, amount);
    }

    function _burnBatch(address from, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC1155: burn from the zero address");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
            require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
            _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
            _totalSupply[id] -= amount;
        }
        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, from, address(0), ids, amounts);
    }

    function burn(address account, uint256 id, uint256 value) public {
        require(account == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(account, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burn(account, id, value);
    }

    function burnBatch(address account, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory values) public {
        require(account == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(account, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burnBatch(account, ids, values);
    }

    function totalSupply(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {

    function promoteTeamMember(address member) public onlyOwner {
        _grantRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE, member);
    }

    // MintPass management
    function addMintPass(bytes32 merkleRoot, uint256 totalSupply_, uint256 maxSupply, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint256 startPrice, string memory uri_, address redeemer, uint256 maxPerTx) public onlyOwner {
        uint256 id = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(merkleRoot, totalSupply_, maxSupply, startTime, endTime, startPrice, uri_, redeemer, maxPerTx)));
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        mp.totalSupply = totalSupply_;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.startTime = startTime;
        mp.endTime = endTime;
        mp.startPrice = startPrice;
        mp.endPrice = startPrice;
        mp.priceDropInterval = 0;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
        mp.redeemer = redeemer;
        mp.isDutchAuction = false;
        mp.exists = true;
        mp.uri = uri_;
        mp.merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
    }

    function editMintPass(bytes32 merkleRoot, uint256 id, uint256 totalSupply_, uint256 maxSupply, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, string memory uri_, address redeemer, bool isDutchAuction, uint256 maxPerTx) public onlyOwner {
        require(_mintPasses[id].exists, "MintPass does not exist");
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        mp.totalSupply = totalSupply_;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.startTime = startTime;
        mp.endTime = endTime;
        mp.uri = uri_;
        mp.redeemer = redeemer;
        mp.isDutchAuction = isDutchAuction;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
        mp.merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
    }

    function editMintPassWhiteListMerkleRoot(bytes32 merkleRoot, uint256 id) public onlyOwner {
        _mintPasses[id].merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
    }

        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        return (mp.totalSupply, mp.maxSupply, mp.startTime, mp.endTime, mp.startPrice, mp.endPrice, mp.priceDropInterval, mp.maxPerTx, mp.claimed[msg.sender], mp.redeemer, mp.isDutchAuction, mp.uri);
    }

        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        mp.isDutchAuction = isDutchAuction;
        mp.startPrice = startPrice;
        mp.endPrice = endPrice;
        mp.startTime = startTime;
        mp.endTime = endTime;
        mp.priceDropInterval = priceDropInterval;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
    }

    function getDutchTiers(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        return (mp.startPrice, mp.endPrice, mp.startTime, mp.endTime, mp.priceDropInterval, mp.maxPerTx, mp.totalSupply);
    }

    function isSaleOpen(uint256 id) public view returns (bool) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        return mp.exists && block.timestamp >= mp.startTime && block.timestamp <= mp.endTime;
    }

    function turnSaleOn(uint256 id) public onlyOwner {
        _mintPasses[id].exists = true;
    }

    function turnSaleOff(uint256 id) public onlyOwner {
        _mintPasses[id].exists = false;
    }

    function getRemainingPassSupply(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _mintPasses[id].maxSupply - _mintPasses[id].totalSupply;

        return _mintPasses[id].claimed[account];
    }

    function getTokenSupply(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupply[id];
    }

    function getPrice(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        if (!mp.isDutchAuction) {
            return mp.startPrice;
        }
        if (block.timestamp < mp.startTime) {
            return mp.startPrice;
        }
        if (block.timestamp >= mp.endTime) {
            return mp.endPrice;
        }
        uint256 timeElapsed = block.timestamp - mp.startTime;
        uint256 totalPriceDrops = (mp.endTime - mp.startTime) / mp.priceDropInterval;
        uint256 priceDropAmount = (mp.startPrice - mp.endPrice) / totalPriceDrops;
        return mp.startPrice - (timeElapsed / mp.priceDropInterval * priceDropAmount);
    }

    function getRemainingTimeBeforeNextPricingChange(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        if (!mp.isDutchAuction) return 0;
        uint256 timeSinceStart = block.timestamp - mp.startTime;
        uint256 intervals = timeSinceStart / mp.priceDropInterval;
        uint256 nextChangeTime = mp.startTime + ((intervals + 1) * mp.priceDropInterval);
        if (nextChangeTime > mp.endTime) return 0;
        return nextChangeTime - block.timestamp;
    }

    // Minting functions
    function mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount) public onlyRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        _mint(to, id, amount, "");
    }

    function mintBatch(address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts) public onlyRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        _mintBatch(to, ids, amounts, "");
    }

    function burnFromRedeem(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) public {
        require(_mintPasses[id].redeemer == msg.sender, "Burnable: Only allowed from redeemer");
        _burn(from, id, amount);
    }

    // Claim functions
    function claim(uint256 id, uint256 amount, uint256 maxAmount, bytes32[] memory merkleProof) public payable whenNotPaused {
        require(_mintPasses[id].exists, "Sale is not a dutch auction");
        require(!_paused, "Sale is paused");
        require(_mintPasses[id].totalSupply + amount <= _mintPasses[id].maxSupply, "No supply remaining");
        require(block.timestamp >= _mintPasses[id].startTime && block.timestamp <= _mintPasses[id].endTime, "Claim: time window closed");
        require(msg.value >= getPrice(id) * amount, "Payment amount is incorrect");
        require(_mintPasses[id].claimed[msg.sender] + amount <= maxAmount, "Claim: Not allowed to claim given amount");
        require(amount <= _mintPasses[id].maxPerTx, "Max quantity per transaction exceeded");
        require(verifyMerkleProof(merkleProof, id, maxAmount), "MerkleDistributor: Invalid proof");

        _mintPasses[id].claimed[msg.sender] += amount;
        _mintPasses[id].totalSupply += amount;
        _mint(msg.sender, id, amount, "");
        emit Claimed(id, msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function claimMultiple(uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, uint256[] memory maxAmounts, bytes32[][] memory merkleProofs) public payable whenNotPaused {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            claim(ids[i], amounts[i], maxAmounts[i], merkleProofs[i]);
        }
        emit ClaimedMultiple(ids, msg.sender, amounts);
    }

    function verifyMerkleProof(bytes32[] memory proof, uint256 id, uint256 maxAmount) public view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, maxAmount));
        bytes32 root = _mintPasses[id].merkleRoot;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            leaf = leaf < proof[i] ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(leaf, proof[i])) : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(proof[i], leaf));
        }
        return leaf == root;
    }

    function makeLeaf(address account, uint256 maxAmount) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account, maxAmount));
    }

    // Withdraw
    function withdrawEther(address payable to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        (bool success, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }
}

    function onERC1155BatchReceived(address operator, address from, uint256[] calldata ids, uint256[] calldata values, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}

    function getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(
        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        AccountLiquidityLocalVars memory vars;
        address[] memory assets = accountAssetsArray[account];
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            address cToken = assets[i];
            (vars.oErr, vars.oTokenBalance, vars.oTokenBorrowBalance, vars.oTokenExchangeRate) = CTokenInterface(cToken).getAccountSnapshot(account);
            if (vars.oErr != 0) {
                return (vars.oErr, 0, 0);
            }
            vars.oTokenCollateralFactor = markets[cToken].collateralFactorMantissa;
            vars.oTokenUnderlyingPrice = PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cToken);
            if (vars.oTokenUnderlyingPrice == 0) {
                return (11, 0, 0);
            }
            vars.oTokenCollateralValue = mul_ScalarTruncate(Truncate(vars.oTokenBalance, vars.oTokenExchangeRate), vars.oTokenCollateralFactor);
            vars.sumCollateral = add_(vars.sumCollateral, vars.oTokenCollateralValue);
            vars.oTokenBorrowValue = mul_ScalarTruncate(vars.oTokenBorrowBalance, vars.oTokenUnderlyingPrice);
            vars.sumBorrowPlusEffects = add_(vars.sumBorrowPlusEffects, vars.oTokenBorrowValue);
            
            if (cToken == cTokenModify) {
                vars.sumBorrowPlusEffects = add_(vars.sumBorrowPlusEffects, mul_ScalarTruncate(borrowAmount, vars.oTokenUnderlyingPrice));

            }
        }
        
        if (vars.sumCollateral > vars.sumBorrowPlusEffects) {
            return (0, sub_(vars.sumCollateral, vars.sumBorrowPlusEffects), 0);

    event Unpaused(address account);

    bool private _paused;
    uint256 private _status;

        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function setContractPause(bool _pause) external onlyOwner {
        if (_paused != _pause) {
            _paused = _pause;
            if (_pause) {
                emit Paused(msg.sender);
            } else {
                emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
            }
        }
    }

        return PARENT_NODE;
    }

        bytes memory b = bytes(name);
        if (b.length == 0) return false;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < b.length; i++) {
            bytes1 char = b[i];
            if (char < 0x80) {

            } else if (char >= 0xe0) {
                return false;
            } else if (char >= 0xf0) {
                return false;
            } else if (char >= 0xf8) {
                return false;
            } else if (char >= 0xfc) {
                return false;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    function claimBase() external whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _checkCanClaim(msg.sender);
        _claim(msg.sender, "");
    }

    function claim(uint256 tokenId, string calldata name) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _checkCanClaim(msg.sender);
        _claim(msg.sender, name);

        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");

        } catch {

        IENS(ENS_REGISTRY).setSubnodeRecord(PARENT_NODE, name, claimant, address(0), 0, 0, 0);
        emit Claimed(claimant, 0, name);
    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC20 {
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

contract DAOVoting {
    address public admin;
    address public artistDAO;
    address public deployingWallet;
    uint256 public daoVotingDuration = 86400;
    uint256 public daoUpdateDelay = 86400;
    uint256 public daoApprovedTime;
    uint256 public maxRewardAmount = 86400;
    uint256 public amountMigrated;
    uint256 public totalLockedVotes;
    uint256 public activeDAONominations;
    bool public airdropEnabled;

    mapping(address => uint256) public daoNominationTime;
    mapping(address => uint256) public daoNominationVotesFor;
    mapping(address => uint256) public daoNominationVotesAgainst;
    mapping(address => address) public daoNominationNominator;
    mapping(address => bool) public daoNominationVotingClosed;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public checkAddressVoteAmount;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) public checkDAOAddressVote;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;

    event NewDAONomination(address indexed nominator, address indexed newDAO);
    event VoteSubmitted(address indexed voter, address indexed newDAO, uint256 amount, bool support);
    event VoteWithdrawn(address indexed voter, address indexed newDAO);
    event VotingClosed(address indexed newDAO, bool approved);
    event Migrated(address indexed user, uint256 amount);

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(admin == msg.sender, "Only admin can call this function");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyDeployingWallet() {
        require(deployingWallet == msg.sender, "Only deploying wallet can call this function");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyV1DAO() {
        require(artistDAO == msg.sender, "Only V1 DAO can complete a migration");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
        deployingWallet = msg.sender;
    }

    function airdrop(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "Address and Amount arrays are not the same size");
        require(airdropEnabled, "Airdrop is not enabled");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            IERC20(artistDAO).transfer(recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
    }

    function toggleAirdrop() external onlyAdmin {
        airdropEnabled = !airdropEnabled;
    }

    function setMaxRewardAmount(uint256 _amount) external onlyAdmin {
        maxRewardAmount = _amount;
    }

    function setMigrationOpen(bool _open) external onlyAdmin {
        require(_open, "Migration must be open on the V2 side");
        artistDAO = msg.sender;
    }

    function updateDAOAddress() external onlyDeployingWallet {
        require(block.timestamp > daoApprovedTime + daoUpdateDelay, "We have not finished the delay for an approved DAO");
        artistDAO = approvedNewDAO();
        daoApprovedTime = 0;
    }

    function nominateNewDAO(address newDAO) external {
        require(IERC20(artistDAO).balanceOf(msg.sender) > 0, "Nominator does not own enough APOLL");
        require(daoNominationTime[newDAO] == 0, "This address has already been nominated");
        daoNominationTime[newDAO] = block.timestamp;
        daoNominationNominator[newDAO] = msg.sender;
        activeDAONominations++;
        emit NewDAONomination(msg.sender, newDAO);
    }

    function voteForDAONomination(uint256 amount, address newDAO, bool support) external {
        require(daoNominationTime[newDAO] != 0, "There is no DAO Nomination for this address");
        require(!daoNominationVotingClosed[newDAO], "Voting has already closed for this nomination");
        require(block.timestamp > daoNominationTime[newDAO] + daoVotingDuration, "We have not passed the minimum voting duration");
        require(!checkDAOAddressVote[msg.sender][newDAO], "User already voted on this nomination");
        require(IERC20(artistDAO).balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "You have not cast votes for this nomination");

        checkDAOAddressVote[msg.sender][newDAO] = true;
        checkAddressVoteAmount[msg.sender][newDAO] = amount;
        totalLockedVotes += amount;

        if (support) {
            daoNominationVotesFor[newDAO] += amount;
        } else {
            daoNominationVotesAgainst[newDAO] += amount;
        }
        emit VoteSubmitted(msg.sender, newDAO, amount, support);
    }

    function withdrawNewDAOVotes(address newDAO) external {
        require(checkDAOAddressVote[msg.sender][newDAO], "You have not cast votes for this nomination");
        uint256 amount = checkAddressVoteAmount[msg.sender][newDAO];
        totalLockedVotes -= amount;
        checkDAOAddressVote[msg.sender][newDAO] = false;
        checkAddressVoteAmount[msg.sender][newDAO] = 0;
        emit VoteWithdrawn(msg.sender, newDAO);
    }

    function closeNewDAOVoting(address newDAO) external {
        require(daoNominationNominator[newDAO] == msg.sender, "Only deploying wallet can call this function");
        require(block.timestamp > daoNominationTime[newDAO] + daoVotingDuration, "We have not passed the minimum voting duration");
        
        bool approved = daoNominationVotesFor[newDAO] > daoNominationVotesAgainst[newDAO];
        if (approved) {
            daoApprovedTime = block.timestamp;
        }
        daoNominationVotingClosed[newDAO] = true;
        activeDAONominations--;
        emit VotingClosed(newDAO, approved);
    }

    function migrateTokens(address user, uint256 amount) external onlyV1DAO {
        amountMigrated += amount;
        IERC20(artistDAO).transfer(user, amount);
        emit Migrated(user, amount);
    }

    function rewardWinner(address winner, uint256 amount) external onlyAdmin {
        require(amount <= maxRewardAmount, "Reward exceeds maximumallowed");
        IERC20(artistDAO).transfer(winner, amount);
    }

    function approvedNewDAO() public view returns (address) {
        return address(0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000);
    }

    function minimumDAOBalance() public pure returns (uint256) {
        return 1;
    }
}
